thread:
Amir: Heads-up — sample-app CI is failing on release candidate because typegen output changed after the OpenAPI bump. I didn't touch SDKs, just updated the spec version.

Carla: ugh, saw that. failing job: https://ci.redwood.ai/job/12345
Carla: error snippet from the job: 
```
FAILED: packages/js/src/generated/apiClient.ts: enum order mismatch
-  export type WidgetState = 'ready' | 'initializing' | 'failed'
+  export type WidgetState = 'initializing' | 'ready' | 'failed'
```
Carla: the generator reordered enums nondeterministically after the openapi generator update.

Ben CI: CI shows a flaky step in codegen + typegen stage. logs: `yarn run build:codegen && yarn run typegen:write` — the codegen step is deterministic but typegen sometimes produces a different serialization order.

Amir: This causes semver churn in the JS SDK (minor vs patch debate). Product wants stable minor bumps only. We need to avoid spurious diffs so changelogs don't get polluted.

Dave: Possible fixes: pin generator version in the monorepo, or make typegen output stable (sort map keys/enums). Could add a post-gen normalization step: `node scripts/stable-sort.js packages/*/src/generated/*.ts`

Emily: What's the immediate mitigation for the release? Do we revert the openapi bump?

Carla: Reverting would be annoying — that spec bump includes a security fix. I propose we hotfix typegen to preserve original enum order when a previous schema has an order field, and otherwise sort alphabetically. I'll open a PR with tests.

Amir: Also request adding a pre-merge hook in the repo to run `yarn typegen:check` which fails if generated files differ. That will catch PRs before CI.

Dave: Agreed. We should also add a lightweight regen-diff CI job that runs only on PRs touching /openapi or /packages/*/schemas. Fast-failing and cached.

Ben CI: I can add a job `typegen-regenerate` that runs in ~45s using the shared cache. Will add to the `pull_request` workflow.

typegen-bot: @Carla opened PR #587: fix(typegen): stable enum order + add snapshot tests — checks pending :eyes:

Carla: PR includes a fixture that reproduced the nondeterministic order. Added a test that runs 20 iterations to catch flakiness: `for i in {1..20}; do yarn typegen:write; git --no-pager diff --exit-code || break; done`

Amir: Nice. After that lands, we should backfill a tiny changelog policy note: "Generator-only formatting changes are patch, not minor" — doc in devex/semver.md.

Emily: Can we also include a release note automation to label releases if only typegen/formatting changed? Saves manual review.

Dave: Yeah — release-robot can scan commits for `typegen:` or only files under `/packages/*/src/generated` and tag as `chore(release): patch`

Ben CI: Rolling the job out now. Will mark the current pipeline as 'allowed failure' until PR merges to avoid blocking the security fix.

Amir: Thanks all. Next steps: Carla PR, Ben adds CI job, Dave implements pre-merge hook guide, Emily drafts semver policy blurb.

Carla: I'll queue the PR for review and include the failing sample-app as a reproduction case so it's covered in e2e.

Amir: ok closing loop — add follow-up notes in the release PR so on-call knows why we tolerated the transient allowed-failure. :thumbsup:
